title: 第6章  丫头的秘密
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
突破炼气三层后，李寒山察觉到花弄影态度起了一些变化，就算表面上仍是百依百顺，一些愤恨之类的微表情，出现的频率却是更高了。
“不能把这妖女逼得太紧了！”
他担心这妖女鱼死网破。
于是，在接下来的修行中，他再度给花弄影一些甜头，还主动跟她聊起筑基的事。
花弄影说起这事，便是一脸愁色：“主人，三个月后就是宗门大考了。奴家若到不了筑基，定会被贬为外门弟子。到那时，不止奴家完了，主人也会跟着倒霉呢。”
李寒山不解：“外门弟子也是合欢宗弟子，宗内禁止内斗，难道还会有人找你麻烦不成。”
花弄影眉间微蹙，眼中泛起一层薄薄的水雾，声音也带上了几分委屈：“如果是普通弟子还好，可奴家不一样，盯着奴家的人太多了，一旦失去内门弟子身份，他们有太多办法对付奴家了。”
说着说着，她快要哭出来了：“到时奴家自身难保，更保不住主人，所以奴家才这么着急。”
李寒山道：“圣女不是给了你秘法，她不会帮你么？”
花弄影摇头：“圣女最近在闭关，很长时间都不会出来了，她也不可能事事帮我。”
“这样么？”
李寒山不知她说的是真是假，为了安抚她，他温声道：“我会尽力帮你的。”
“主人，你太好了。”
花弄影眼睫低垂，一副感动至极的模样，顺势扑进了他怀里。
这次聊天之后，李寒山确实每一次给了花弄影更多好处，但也控制了量，让花弄影不至于失去希望，又不会一下子突破筑基。
他自己的修为增长因此慢了下来，但离炼气四层越来越近。
满打满算，他踏上修行之路还不到一个月。一个百岁老头子，这么短的时间里就突破炼气三层，简直是奇迹。
“终于又梦到了！”
几天后，终于，李寒山再次进入神秘梦境。
洛璃每次都比他更早一些到来，她正坐在石头上，望着天空出神。

“丫头...丫头...？”
“啊，大爷，你来啦......太好了，我还以为你......”
李寒山喊了两遍，她才恍然回神。看清是他后，洛璃雀跃着从石头上跃下，几步来到他身边，水汪汪的眼中盈满喜悦。
“丫头，我活下来了！”
见少女这般开心，李寒山心情跟着大好，他与少女坐在河边青石上，将反杀花弄影的经过细细说了一遍。
这等私密之事讲出来，说的人还好，听的人却是连脖子都涂上了一抹绯色。
“没想到那妖女这等狠辣，还好阳册功法足够霸道。”
听完后，少女不由为李寒山捏了一把汗。
那一场反杀，属实不容易。
李寒山想起心魔誓约，问道：“对了，丫头，那妖女立下的心魔誓约稳妥吗？”
少女秀眉微蹙：“心魔誓约本身没什么问题，但要看她用的是什么契纸，若是契纸不够高级，那便只对炼气期有用。”
少女的话，坐实了李寒山的担忧：“这么说，那契纸恐怕还真有问题。”
闻言，少女点头：“应当如此，大爷你要小心了，千万别让她筑基，否则心魔誓约极可能失效。”
“嗯！”
李寒山知道厉害：“放心吧，我隔三岔五吸她，她想要筑基没那么容易的。”
说到这里，李寒山又将花弄影说的宗门考核一事说了一下。
少女听完，蹙着秀眉想了一会儿，道：“大爷，她的话应该有几分真的，如果是这样，大爷你的时间就不多了。”
时间确实不多了。
宗门考核的事，应该不是假的，就算考核通不过后果没那么严重，那妖女很可能也会挺而走险，再度对李寒山出手。
“大爷您也不必太担心，那妖女表现得如此顺从，我估计她恐怕是看到了阳册的价值，所以她应该不会选择去揭发您。”

“丫头，还得是你。”
洛璃的分析，让李寒山茅塞顿开，他一直奇怪，那妖女为什么那么顺从，只当她是在隐忍，却没想到这一层。
这不怪他，他初入修仙界，还没有意识到阳册功法的真正价值。
少女继续出起了主意：
“大爷，关键还是要将你自己的修为提升上去，再看看有没有办法摆脱炉鼎身份，成为合欢宗的正式弟子，这样说不定有机会逃出去。”
李寒山点头：“嗯！我现在已经炼气三层了！”
“炼气三层？”
少女神色微讶：“看来是阳册的功劳，对了，大爷，阳册你还记得吗？”
李寒山不知道少女为什么这么问，点头道：“当然记得，怎么了，丫头？”
“我记不得了。”
“啊？”
少女的话，让李寒山不解：“怎么回事？”
“自上次将阳册传给大爷后，我便忘得干干净净，一个字也想不起，想来，这阳册应该具备唯一性，只有一人能学会。”
少女解释。
她这一解释，李寒山的疑惑反而更多了：“丫头，你难道没抄录一份？”
少女摇头：“阳册无法抄录，大爷试一下便知道了。”
竟然还无法抄录，这阳册当真是神奇。
“大爷，不说这个了，趁还有时间，我教大爷一些法诀跟术法，大爷可以用来巩固修为和自保。”
“好，辛苦你了，丫头。”
洛璃将阳册之事抛诸脑后，决意借梦境助李寒山修炼。李寒山心中感激，自然全心配合。

说是修炼，其实与上次一样，洛璃手把手的教学。
这个梦境真实得可怕，梦中的接触几乎与现实别无二致。双方触碰之时，少女柔嫩肌肤带来的触感清晰无比。
虽说如此，李寒山却未生半点邪念。少女如此帮他，他若还有什么歪心思，岂不是禽兽不如？
梦中无岁月，这一修炼，就不知道过了多久，直到这李寒山被尿憋醒。
“对了，大爷，你看下腰间有没有什么东西......”
在梦境快要消散的那一刻，洛璃略作迟疑，低声提醒李寒山。
她说的是那秘纹？
李寒山反应过来，旋即，他意识到另一个问题，丫头是怎么知道这件事的，难不成丫头......
“不可能！”
他直接把这种可能否定，丫头不可能跟别人修炼过这功法，这一点他毫不怀疑。
“还是说，丫头独自尝试过修炼，所以知道这秘纹？”
李寒山猜测的同时，意识从梦境抽离，身体各处的知觉如水漫般涌回——后背贴着柔软的床褥，鼻尖萦绕着花弄影身上淡淡的幽香，耳畔是她均匀绵长的呼吸。
他睁开眼，便看到花弄影侧躺在旁，她睡颜恬静，身上只着了件轻薄的寝衣，衣襟微敞，露出一截白皙的锁骨。
似乎察觉到李寒山醒来，她长长的睫毛颤了颤，缓缓睁开一双勾人的眼眸。
这妖女，确实是人间绝色，看得李寒山心头微荡，食指大动。
“主人，你终于醒了。”花弄影面露惊喜，小手拍着饱满的胸脯：“你睡了足足两天，可担心死奴家了。”
“又睡了两天？”
李寒山慢慢摸到了梦境的规律，每一次醒来，似乎都是身体支撑不住，或者被外力干扰。
“主人，你没事吧？”
花弄影的美眸中满是关怀，这倒不是伪装，她的担心是真的。李寒山身怀的绝世功法还没到手，她可舍不得李寒山挂了。

“我没事。”
李寒山起身，到外面去放了个水。
接下来，李寒山每次跟花弄影修炼完，都会用丫头传的法诀巩固一番，其它时间则用来修炼术法。
丫头在梦境中教了李寒山三门术法，一门攻击，一门防御，还有一门步法。
“大爷，我虽然不知道你的灵根属性，但先天纯阳圣体肯定是以火灵根为主的，所以这三门术法都是火属性，一为火弹术，一为火墙术，一为火影步，都是最简单的术法......”
丫头的话历历在目。
有了梦境中手把手的教学，李寒山没用多久，便将三门术法尽数学会。
“轰！”
一个火弹自李寒山的指尖冲出，在院子后的山崖上炸出了一个碗口大小的洞。
“威力不错！”
李寒山初次拥有攻击术法，一连发了好几个火弹，体内的灵力便不剩什么了，再也发不出新的火球。
他有些不满意：“才八个，这也太少了。”
花弄影的声音突然响起：“主人，这些洞是你炸出来的？”
李寒山回头，发现花弄影不知何时来到了自己不远处，他心中一凝，这妖女的实力果然强悍，自己竟没一点察觉她的到来。
“嗯，是我。”他点头。
花弄影的目光扫过那六个洞，眼眸中异彩连连：“主人，你这火球的威力，可是有炼气四五层的威力呢。”
火球？他施展的明明是火弹，不过两者也差不多，他没有否认：“真有这么大？难道是因为我是纯阳圣体的缘故？”
花弄影摇头，道：“不，是因为主人您施展的应该是失传已久的远古术法，所以才能一次性释放六个火球，威力也如此之大！”
远古术法？
李寒山一愣，细问一番后，明白了。

以炼气三层的灵力量，一次性能释放五个火球就不错了，他的灵力并不比别人多，能释放八个，纯粹是因为他施展的术法更加的高明，能够用更少的灵力，做到更大的威力。
而他施展术法的手势，在花弄影的观察中，正是失传的远古术法！
“主人，您的秘密很多呢。”
花弄影并未追问远古术法是从哪里来的，但看向他的目光，却是亮了几分，仿佛在看一件稀世珍宝一般。
“这妖女，怕是又惦记上我的术法了。”
李寒山心中一凝，随即想到另一个问题：“丫头又是阳册，又有远古术法，她到底是谁？”
content_en:
After breaking through the third level of Qi refining, Li Hanshan noticed some changes in Hua Nongying's attitude. Even though she was still obedient on the surface, some micro-expressions such as resentment appeared more frequently.
"Don't push this witch too hard!"
He was worried that this enchantress would be defeated.
So, in the following practice, he once again gave Hua Nongying some sweetness, and even took the initiative to talk to her about foundation building.
When Hua Nongying talked about this, she had a sad look on her face: "Master, the sect's big exam will be in three months. If the slave family cannot arrive at the foundation building, they will definitely be demoted to outer disciples. By then, not only the slave family will be ruined, but the master will also be in trouble."
Li Hanshan was puzzled: "The outer disciples are also disciples of the Hehuan Sect. Internal fighting is prohibited within the sect. Could it be that someone would still cause trouble for you?"
Hua Nongying frowned slightly, a thin layer of mist appeared in her eyes, and her voice was a little aggrieved: "It would be fine if it were an ordinary disciple, but it is different with the Nu family. There are too many people staring at the Nu family. Once they lose their status as inner disciples, they will have too many ways to deal with the Nu family."
As she spoke, she was about to cry: "The slave family will not be able to protect itself, let alone the master, that's why the slave family is so anxious."
Li Hanshan said: "Didn't the saint give you the secret method? Wouldn't she help you?"
Hua Nongying shook her head: "The saint is in retreat recently and won't come out for a long time. She can't help me with everything."
"Is that so?"
Li Hanshan didn't know whether what she said was true or not, so in order to comfort her, he said warmly: "I will try my best to help you."
"Master, you are so kind."
Hua Nongying lowered her eyelashes, looking extremely moved, and threw herself into his arms.
After this chat, Li Hanshan did give Hua Nongying more benefits every time, but he also controlled the amount so that Hua Nongying would not lose hope and would not break through the foundation building all at once.
His own cultivation growth slowed down as a result, but he was getting closer and closer to the fourth level of Qi Refining.
With full plans, it had been less than a month since he embarked on the path of spiritual practice. For a hundred-year-old man to break through the third level of Qi refining in such a short period of time is simply a miracle.
"Finally dreamed again!"
A few days later, Li Hanshan finally entered the mysterious dreamland again.
Luo Li arrived earlier than him every time. She was sitting on the stone, looking at the sky in trance.
"Girl... girl...?"
"Ah, uncle, you're here...that's great, I thought you..."
Li Hanshan shouted twice before she suddenly came back to her senses. After seeing clearly that it was him, Luo Li jumped down from the stone with joy and came to his side in a few steps, her watery eyes filled with joy.
"Girl, I survived!"
Seeing the girl so happy, Li Hanshan was in a good mood. He and the girl sat on the bluestone by the river and recounted in detail the story of the rebellion against Hua Nongying.
When such private matters are told, the person who tells them is okay, but the people who listen have a trace of scarlet on their necks.
"I didn't expect that witch to be so ruthless. Fortunately, Yang Ce's technique is domineering enough."
After listening, the girl couldn't help but sweat for Li Hanshan.
That counterattack was really not easy.
Li Hanshan thought of the inner demon oath and asked: "By the way, girl, is the inner demon oath made by the demon girl safe?"
The girl frowned slightly: "There is nothing wrong with the inner demon oath itself, but it depends on what kind of contract paper she uses. If the contract paper is not high-end enough, it will only be useful for the Qi refining period."
The girl's words confirmed Li Hanshan's worries: "So, there may be something wrong with the deed paper."
Hearing this, the girl nodded: "It should be so, uncle, you have to be careful, don't let her build the foundation, otherwise the inner demon oath will most likely become invalid."
"Yeah!"
Li Hanshan knew how powerful it was: "Don't worry, I'll suck her every now and then. It's not that easy for her to build a foundation."
At this point, Li Hanshan talked about the sect's assessment that Hua Nongying said.
After hearing this, the girl frowned and thought for a while, then said: "Uncle, what she said should be somewhat true. If so, uncle, you don't have much time."
Time is indeed running out.
The matter of the sect's assessment should not be false. Even if the consequences of failing the assessment are not that serious, the demon girl will probably take the risk and attack Li Hanshan again.
"Uncle, you don't have to worry too much. The demon girl is so obedient. I guess she sees the value of the book, so she won't choose to expose you."
"Girl, it has to be you."
Luo Li's analysis made Li Hanshan suddenly enlightened. He had always wondered why the witch was so obedient. He only thought that she was forbearing, but he didn't expect this level.
It's not his fault. He had just entered the world of immortality and had not yet realized the true value of the Yang Book Cultivation Technique.
The girl continued to come up with ideas:
"Uncle, the key is to improve your own cultivation level, and then see if there is a way to get rid of the identity of the furnace tripod and become an official disciple of the Hehuan Sect. In this way, you might have a chance to escape."
Li Hanshan nodded: "Yes! I have reached the third level of Qi refining now!"
"Third level of Qi refining?"
The girl looked slightly surprised: "It seems that it is Yang Ce's credit. By the way, uncle, do you still remember Yang Ce?"
Li Hanshan didn't know why the girl asked, so he nodded and said, "Of course I remember, what's the matter, girl?"
"I can't remember."
"Huh?"
The girl's words puzzled Li Hanshan: "What's going on?"
"Since the last time I passed the Yang book to the uncle, I have completely forgotten it and can't remember a single word. Come to think of it, this Yang book should be unique and only one person can learn it."
The girl explained.
Her explanation made Li Hanshan more confused: "Girl, didn't you make a copy?"
The girl shook her head: "Yang Book cannot be copied. I will know after you try it."
It's still impossible to copy, this Yang book is really magical.
"Uncle, let's not talk about this. While there is still time, I will teach you some tricks and techniques. You can use them to consolidate your cultivation and protect yourself."
"Okay, thank you for your hard work, girl."
Luo Li put the matter of Yang Ce behind him and decided to use dreams to help Li Hanshan practice. Li Hanshan was grateful and naturally cooperated wholeheartedly.
It was said to be training, but in fact it was the same as last time, with Luo Li teaching step by step.
This dream was terrifyingly real, and the contact in the dream was almost indistinguishable from reality. When the two sides touched, the touch of the girl's soft skin was extremely clear.
Even so, Li Hanshan didn't have any evil thoughts. If the girl helped him like this, if he had any evil intentions, wouldn't he be worse than a beast?
There is no time in the dream. I don’t know how long this practice lasted until Li Hanshan woke up from peeing.
"By the way, uncle, look at your waist to see if there is anything..."
At the moment when the dream was about to dissipate, Luo Li hesitated for a moment and reminded Li Hanshan in a low voice.
Is she talking about the secret pattern?
Li Hanshan reacted, and soon he realized another question, how did the girl know about this? Could it be that the girl...
"Impossible!"
He directly denied this possibility. It was impossible for the girl to practice this technique with others. He had no doubt about this.
"Or is it that the girl has tried practicing on her own, so she knows this secret pattern?"
While Li Hanshan was guessing, his consciousness was withdrawn from the dream, and all the sensations in his body came back like water - his back was pressed against the soft mattress, his nose was lingering with the faint fragrance of Hua Nongying, and her even and long breathing was in his ears.
When he opened his eyes, he saw Hua Nongying lying on her side. She was sleeping peacefully. She was only wearing a light nightgown. The skirt was slightly open, revealing a section of her white collarbone.
As if aware that Li Hanshan had woken up, her long eyelashes trembled and she slowly opened a pair of seductive eyes.
This enchantress was truly stunning in the world. Li Hanshan's heart was slightly moved and his index finger moved when he saw her.
"Master, you are finally awake." Hua Nongying said with surprise on her face.He patted his plump chest with his little hand and said, "You have slept for two full days, but you are worried about your death."
"Slept for two more days?"
Li Hanshan slowly figured out the pattern of dreams. Every time he woke up, it seemed that his body could not support himself or was disturbed by external forces.
"Master, are you okay?"
Hua Nongying's beautiful eyes were full of concern. This was not a disguise, her worries were real. She couldn't bear to let Li Hanshan die before she could obtain the peerless skills he possessed.
"I'm fine."
Li Hanshan got up and went outside to put some water.
Next, every time Li Hanshan finished practicing with Hua Nongying, he would use the magic formula passed down by Yatou to consolidate it, and spend the rest of his time practicing the magic technique.
The girl taught Li Hanshan three techniques in the dream, one for attack, one for defense, and one for footwork.
"Uncle, although I don't know the attributes of your spiritual roots, the innate Pure Yang Holy Body must be dominated by fire spiritual roots, so these three techniques are all fire attributes. One is the fire bullet technique, the other is the fire wall technique, and the other is the Hokage Step. They are all the simplest techniques..."
The girl’s words are still fresh in my mind.
With the step-by-step instruction in the dream, it didn't take long for Li Hanshan to master all three techniques.
"Boom!"
A fire bomb rushed out from Li Hanshan's fingertips, blasting a hole the size of a bowl on the cliff behind the yard.
"The power is pretty good!"
Li Hanshan had an attack spell for the first time. After firing several fireballs in a row, there was no spiritual power left in his body and he could no longer fire out new fireballs.
He was a little dissatisfied: "There are only eight, which is too few."
Hua Nongying's voice suddenly sounded: "Master, did you blow up these holes?"
Li Hanshan turned around and found that Hua Nongying had arrived not far from him at some point. His heart froze. This demon girl was really powerful, but he didn't notice her arrival at all.
"Yeah, it's me." He nodded.
Hua Nongying's gaze swept across the six holes, and her eyes were full of brilliant colors: "Master, the power of your fireball is as powerful as the fourth or fifth level of Qi Refining."
Fireball? What he used was obviously a fire bomb, but the two were similar. He did not deny it: "Is it really that big? Is it because I am a pure Yang holy body?"
Hua Nongying shook his head and said: "No, it's because Master, you must be using a long-lost ancient magic. That's why you can release six fireballs at once, and it's so powerful!"
Ancient magic?
Li Hanshan was stunned for a moment, and after asking carefully, he understood.
With the spiritual power of the third level of Qi Refining, it is good to be able to release five fireballs at one time. His spiritual power is not more than others, and he can release eight purely because the spells he performs are more sophisticated and can achieve greater power with less spiritual power.
And according to Hua Nongying's observation, the gestures he used to perform the magic were exactly the lost ancient magic!
"Master, you have many secrets."
Hua Nongying did not ask where the ancient magic came from, but her eyes lit up when she looked at him, as if she was looking at a rare treasure.
"I'm afraid this witch is obsessed with my magic again."
Li Hanshan's heart condensed, and then he thought of another question: "This girl is Yang Ce, and she has ancient magic skills. Who is she?"
